Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?
Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.
What We Do
Sony Interactive Entertainment is the company behind PlayStation. We build tools, and experiences used by players and development teams across the PlayStation ecosystem.
Our team develops and maintains a multi-platform application framework that helps internal teams build rich PlayStation user experiences. The framework combines React Native, native platform integration, reusable UI components, SDK tooling, and developer documentation.
Are You Looking For A Challenge?
We are looking for a Software Engineer to help develop, maintain, and improve the application framework powering PlayStation user experiences across multiple platforms. You will work across JavaScript/TypeScript, native platform integration, C++, build systems, and SDK packaging.
The ideal candidate has strong software engineering fundamentals, real interest in framework and runtime work, and experience building reusable software such as SDKs, libraries, native modules, or cross-platform developer. Experience with React Native or Apple platforms such as iOS or macOS is a strong plus.
What You Will Be Doing
Implement, debug, and maintain application framework features across JavaScript/TypeScript and native layers.
Build and improve developer-facing APIs, native modules, framework components, and integration paths used by application teams.
Contribute to native framework code in C++.

Corteva Agriscience is seeking a hands-on Research Associate to help build field research capabilities at a growing agricultural research center in the Indianapolis area. In this role, you will join the Integrated Field Science team and support high-quality, multi-crop field research from trial setup through harvest and closeout. You will work alongside scientists, agronomy colleagues, and technical partners to execute research protocols, maintain research plots, collect reliable data, and keep field operations running safely and efficiently. Working with minimal guidance, you will also conduct experiments and complex technical activities, interpret results, refine methodologies, and recommend practical next steps. This is an opportunity to apply your agricultural experience and scientific judgment while helping shape the capabilities and culture of a highly visible research center.

## What you'll do

* Help plan and conduct field research trials, including site preparation, planting, treatment application, crop maintenance, sampling, assessment, harvest, and trial closeout.
* Working with minimal guidance, conduct experiments, complex technical operations, and information-search or analysis projects.
* Optimize, interpret, and independently adapt methodologies for current projects; recommend additional experiments or alternative approaches when appropriate.
* Recognize erroneous or unexpected results, analyze and interpret findings, draw sound conclusions, and recommend a path forward.
* Contribute to work plans and manage daily workflow to deliver accurate, timely research results.
* Execute research protocols accurately and collect, record, quality-check, and organize field data for use in project summaries and reports.
* Operate, transport, maintain, and help troubleshoot agricultural and research equipment used for application, planting, harvesting, sensing, and data collection.
* Coordinate day-to-day field activities with scientists, agronomy colleagues, seasonal employees, interns, contractors, and technical partners across on-site and off-site research locations.
* Promote strong standards for safety, stewardship, compliance, data integrity, equipment care, and continuous improvement.
* Support field demonstrations, tours, and other activities that connect agricultural research with customers, partners, and visitors.

##

## Why this role matters:

The Indianapolis-area research center is being developed as a hub for agricultural research, innovation, learning, and internal and external engagement. Job Category Software Engineering Job Details About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. About the Team Accessibility is one of the hardest problems in software: it touches every component, every developer, and every user, and it's historically been slow, manual, and reactive. The Component Accessibility Team (CAT) is changing that. We improve accessibility by focusing on the developer experience: we build AI tools that shift accessibility as far left as possible, so developers don't have to be accessibility experts to write perfectly accessible code. We build the accessibility agent as a product : the knowledge, the fix tools, and the evaluation systems that let any Salesforce engineer request and receive accessible code suggestions in the flow of their work. Our tools ship into the surfaces developers already use: AI Expert Suite, DX MCP, Cursor, Claude Code, and Vibes. When a developer writes a component, we make it WCAG-compliant before the code makes it to production. This is a business problem, not only an ethical one. By improving accessibility at Salesforce we help win deals. It unlocks the features sales needs to close public-sector and enterprise contracts, and it protects Salesforce from a fast-growing wave of legal and regulatory risk. Accessibility serves the 1.3 billion people worldwide who live with disabilities, and it's increasingly a condition of doing business: ADA digital-accessibility lawsuits have increased every year since 2018, and VPAT conformance is now a standard requirement in enterprise and public-sector procurement. The US federal government can't buy software that fails Section 508, and the EU's European Accessibility Act extended the same bar to Europe in June 2025. Accessible-by-default code is how Salesforce keeps winning deals in the public sector, including with agencies that serve millions of veterans who have disabilities. The CAT accessibility product is already running at scale. Our Prizm PR-review presubmit is live on core and offcore and has reviewed 42,845 pull requests since late May. Engineers acted on 21% of its findings, and only 1% were ever reported incorrect. When this team gives an accessibility recommendation, it's almost always right, and it's landing in engineers' pull requests thousands of times a week. What the Team Is Responsible For Creating products that increase developer productivity — turning accessibility from a manual, after-the-fact audit into an automated, in-loop part of writing code. Guiding the company's web development efforts as the WCAG lead — ensuring compliance with accessibility guidelines and best practices across Salesforce's UI. Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

We're building the foundational infrastructure that will define how the world thinks about and deploys AI, and we want the sharpest, most curious people to help us do it. As a member of our Analytics & Data Insights team, you'll tackle the kind of problems that don't have textbook answers yet, launch products that didn't exist a year ago, and help enterprises understand what foundational AI actually means for their bottom line.

As a Data Engineer, you will:

- Work directly on new customer experiences built on one of the most advanced AI systems in the world

- Collaborate daily with researchers and engineers who are some of the best in the world at what they do

- Run implementations end-to-end and see initiatives through to real outcomes

- Partner across research, marketing, sales, and finance to help define how Cohere grows, with your recommendations feeding directly into products and strategy

You may be a good fit if you have:

- 5+ years of experience working on production-grade data processing systems

- Strong command of Python and SQL

- Experience with distributed data processing frameworks such as Apache Beam, Spark, or Flink, alongside large-scale data system design

- The ability to transform unstructured data into performant datasets in relational databases and blob storage

- Familiarity with modern analytics stack tooling such as BigQuery, Airflow, or dbt

- Knowledge of Java or Golang (nice to have)

- Experience with Kubernetes (nice to have)

- Genuine excitement about AI - you follow the research, have opinions, and enjoy being in the weeds

- Comfort operating at the edge of what's known, with a desire to build something genuinely new rather than optimise what already exists

FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

- A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

- Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

- RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

- 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

- Annual enrichment benefits:

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

- 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

- Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

- Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

- For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

- For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

- Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

Job Description

About the Role

This role will join the FIS GTM and Sales Enablement organization as a senior member of the Field Enablement team. The Senior Field Enablement Analyst will lead the design and delivery of the solution knowledge, playbooks and on-demand learning our sales organization needs to sell with confidence. Reporting to the Director, Field Enablement, this role owns bringing GTM and product launch content to life for the field through sales playbooks, sales training, video content, e-learning and Power Learning modules delivered through our sales enablement platform (Seismic).

The successful candidate will be technology and AI savvy, using AI routinely across different platforms, such as Copilot, Claude, Jasper and Seismic, including AI-enabled role-play, to strengthen seller knowledge and performance, accelerate content creation, improve workflows and drive automation. This is a great opportunity for an experienced, collaborative and commercially minded enablement professional who enjoys processing complex product and solution content and turning it into clear, engaging learning for sales. The role suits someone who works with a high degree of autonomy across multiple platforms, influences stakeholders at all levels in a global matrix organization and constructively challenges existing processes where a simpler, smarter or more scalable approach is possible.

**Must be located in EST**

What You Will Be Doing

· Own the creation and maintenance of solution and product sales playbooks, ensuring content is aligned to GTM messaging and launch timelines.

· Build, publish and maintain Power Learning modules and knowledge assessments for sellers and presales via our sales enablement platform (Seismic).

· Lead the design of AI-enabled role-play scenarios and practice content to support seller readiness ahead of client conversations.

· Translate GTM and product launch briefs into field-ready enablement programs, partnering closely with Product Marketing and GTM stakeholders to shape launch readiness plans.

· Own the Seismic content and knowledge base, defining and upholding content governance standards so sellers can quickly find current, accurate materials.

· Manage Digital Sales Room (DSR) templates and launch communications that accompany new solution releases and connect sellers to relevant enablement content.

· Define, track and report on enablement adoption and impact metrics, including playbook usage, knowledge assessment completion and Power Learning engagement, and turn insights into recommendations for leadership.

· Lead onboarding and first-year seller enablement programs, including cohort tracking, reminders and completion monitoring.

· Own internal field communications, such as newsletters and launch updates, that keep the field informed of new content and programs.

· Drive the day-to-day operating rhythm of the Field Enablement function, including status reporting to leadership, prioritization and coordination across priority initiatives.

· Act as a trusted voice of the field, gathering seller and presales feedback to continuously improve content and delivery.

· Work across multiple platforms and formats to review source content, extract the most relevant information and convert it into clear, engaging learning for sales.

· Constructively challenge existing processes and recommend improvements where they can enhance the seller experience, content quality or delivery efficiency.

· Identify and lead practical automation opportunities, test improved ways of working and simplify or scale Field Enablement processes.

· Create and configure fit-for-purpose AI agents or reusable prompts, where appropriate, to support content processing, learning development and repeatable enablement workflows.

· Use AI tools as part of daily work across content, learning and productivity platforms, applying sound judgement to improve quality, speed and consistency.

· Apply a practical understanding of sales processes, frameworks, methodologies and CRM workflows when developing playbooks, learning content and seller guidance.

· Use emerging enablement technology, including AI role-play, to provide scalable practice opportunities that strengthen seller knowledge, confidence and performance.

· Create practical e-learning experiences that convert approved source content into structured, engaging and measurable learning for sellers and presales.

· Design and deliver sales training sessions, both virtual and in person where required, to support solution knowledge, launch readiness and reinforcement.

· Create short-form learning and enablement videos that make solution knowledge accessible, engaging and easy for sellers to consume on demand.

· Produce internal deal-win success stories by gathering input from sellers and translating their experiences into clear, engaging content that shares effective approaches and lessons across the sales organization.

· Mentor and guide more junior team members, sharing best practice and acting as a subject-matter expert on enablement tools, content standards and ways of working.

Experience and Qualifications

· Minimum of 5–7 years of experience plus in sales enablement, marketing, or a relevant sales-facing role, with a proven track record of owning enablement initiatives end to end.

· Learning & Development, training delivery or coaching experience is a strong plus.

· Proven experience leading content management and content governance processes.

· Proven ability to influence and build trusted relationships in a global matrix organization, collaborating across functions, regions and stakeholder groups, including senior leaders.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex product information for a field audience.

· Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

· Technology and AI savvy, with confidence using AI daily across different platforms and a willingness to learn new tools quickly.

· Proficient in the Microsoft application suite, especially PowerPoint.

· Positive, team-oriented attitude with strong attention to detail.

· Continuous-improvement mindset, with the confidence to question existing approaches and suggest constructive, scalable improvements.

· Automation mindset, with hands-on experience creating agents, reusable prompts or streamlined workflows when they add practical value.

· Able to review, structure and simplify complex source content, then transform it into effective learning and enablement materials for sales.

· Fast learner who can move confidently between platforms, processes and content types.

· Solid understanding of what effective sales processes, sales frameworks and sales methodologies look like, and how enablement supports consistent seller execution

· Working knowledge of customer relationship management (CRM) platforms, such as Salesforce, and how sellers use CRM within the sales process.

· Able to apply learning-design principles to create effective e-learning, video and practice-based experiences for sales audiences.

· Comfortable presenting and facilitating clear, engaging sales training for virtual or in-person audiences.

· Video editing skills, with experience using tools such as Microsoft Clipchamp and Synthesia to create clear, engaging learning and enablement content.

· Minimum Bachelor's degree required; a postgraduate degree is a strong plus.

Bonus Experience

· Direct experience with Seismic or a similar sales enablement or content management platform.

· Experience creating e-learning content, assessments or facilitating training sessions.

· Fintech or financial services industry experience.

· Experience building or configuring AI agents, prompt libraries or workflow automations using tools such as Copilot, Jasper or similar platforms.
